name: External Investigation Instrument 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of instrument or product to which the investigation refers, as published in an external investigation instrument code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CHQB.name: Cheque
CHQB.definition: Investigation is related to a cheque.

INST.name: Instant Credit Transfer
INST.definition: Investigation is related to an instant credit transfer.

XBCT.name: Cross Border Credit Transfer
XBCT.definition: Investigation is related to a cross border payment.

ACHP.name: ACH Or Mass
ACHP.definition: Investigation is related to an ACH or mass payment.

DDTP.name: Direct Debit
DDTP.definition: Investigation is related to a direct debit.

CARD.name: Card
CARD.definition: Investigation is related to a card transaction.

URGP.name: HVP Or Wire
URGP.definition: Investigation is related to a wire/high value payment.

STAT.name: Statement Entry
STAT.definition: Investigation is related to a statement entry.

DRFT.name: Draft
DRFT.definition: Investigation is related to a draft.

SRTP.name: Request To Pay
SRTP.definition: Investigation is related to a request to pay.
